mcreator_animation_entity_guard.conversion: @ModifyVariable (argsOnly, HEAD) on each mod's EntityAnimationFactory.onEntityTick: a plain LivingTickEvent whose entity is not a GeckoLib GeoEntity is handed to the method as null, so its own first test returns; the 1.0.19 *_animation_entity_guard design with a run-time flag. Each mixin is applied only when its target matches the target_guard fingerprint of the tested build (bons.furious.patch.mcreator_entity_guards.EntityGuardsPlugin / TargetGuards), so one changed mod stands aside alone; the guard list holds the Forge methods every handler uses. Targets: the two factories the guard measurably speeds up (Born in Chaos, 83 tested classes; Luminous Beasts, 35); 16 more MCreator factories were measured and left out (no gain)
